items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I remember there were times when the bass player, Roy Johnson, the bass player before me, was playing with the band and I could...I'd have the instrument out, playing along with it, off stage.

ctx.x: I've often seen cases where a bass player, since we're talking about the instrument, would have a better concept of notes to use in a chord than the guy who might be writing it, because he's just writing basic chord symbols down, you know. We may have a better choice of note to play against the chord.

Anyhow, with that little knowledge I had about chord symbols, plus I could hear what was going on...I remember there were times when the bass player, Roy Johnson, the bass player before me, was playing with the band and I could...I'd have the instrument out, playing along with it, off stage.
